title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1967-10-22

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1967 set featuring the historic first performance of The Other One and a soaring Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The upgraded soundboard recording sounds astonishingly clear for a ’67 show, delivering crisp instrument separation that lets every jam shine. Fans rave about the incendiary first outing of The Other One, the radiant Lovelight, and the relentless energy that carries through the entire set, making this one of the year’s standout performances.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are overwhelmingly positive (mostly 5‑star) praising both the musical performance and the excellent soundboard quality; no negative feedback was found.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered upgrade described as crisp, clean, and surprisingly clear for a 1967 source; no complaints about drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy flow with tight transitions; reviewers note a dynamic rise from laid‑back moments into powerful jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers call his playing "smoking", "shreds", and praise his guitar tone throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ on The Other One is highlighted as top‑notch, reflecting strong early keyboard work.
